caption:
A crossed-out price is not a price history.

The compare-at field is a reference number. By itself, it does not tell you when you charged that amount, or how your price changed.

Keep records before writing a “was” price. Give customers clear labels rather than asking one number to tell the whole story.

India Prior Price records Shopify prices automatically and can show an observed prior price after enough history and an eligible reduction. Coming soon. Follow for launch.
